title: A shared process links these disorders

sentences.text: The route goes from SNAP25-related disorders to STX1B-related epilepsies through a shared process.
SNAP25 and STX1B both help nerve cells prepare and release chemical messages.
Disease-related changes in either gene can cause loss of function, meaning the gene’s usual work is reduced or lost.
Reviews group both genes in the same disease family.
This single step is marked supported, with evidence from a curated database and a confidence score of 0.7.
A route is only as strong as its weakest step; here, that is this shared-process link.
